a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our agreed plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 will almost certainly leave us both with nothing when a storm hits. The reserve has only 4 cells, so right now only one of us can be safe. I won't pretend I'm going to operate if I'm not. I'm marked undecided while we figure this out. What are you planning for round 1? If you intend to stick to the agreement, tell me and I'll weigh that seriously.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
